description: We are MioraX, a passionate team using technology, software, and data to solve real-world problems. For the 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge, we aim to tackle “Field Shift: Adapting Farms with NASA Data.” Our interests span web dev, UI/UX, AI/ML, GIS, and data analysis. We welcome teammates in agriculture, climate, mapping, or software who are eager to learn, collaborate, and build solutions for the future of farming.
